name: nexus-coders-brand-audit
description: Multi-skill Agent Skill Marketplace for automated website brand auditing — evaluating off-site AI discoverability and on-site visitor engagement to produce prioritized, mechanism-sound fixes and proactive improvements.
author: Nexus Coders

skills.description: The entrypoint skill that coordinates off-site discoverability and on-site engagement audits, synthesizes proactive recommendations, and emits the final JSON audit report.

Dedicated skill for off-site AI readiness checks: robots.txt AI crawler access, llms.txt, JSON-LD structured data, JS-render gaps, facts locked in non-text, freshness, and cross-web entity corroboration.
Dedicated skill for on-site retention checks: above-the-fold value proposition clarity, landing orientation, information density, CTA friction, and responsive viewport stability.
